Game Overview

Wild Animal Care And Salon is a animal title where dive into the wild world of animal care. Run a unique salon where you nurture, feed, and groom your furry clients. With click-and-drag mechanics, discover each animal's distinct needs and behaviors. Master attention to detail and unlock new challenges in this captivating simulation experience.
